form.label: AD-DetectLab — Attack Detection Overview
form.description: Correlated detections for Kerberoasting, AS-REP Roasting, DCSync, Golden Ticket, and Pass-the-Hash

search.query: index=ad_lab EventCode=4769 Ticket_Encryption_Type=0x17 Account_Name!="*$" | stats count by Account_Name | where count > 5 | stats count
index=ad_lab EventCode=4768 Pre_Authentication_Type=0 | stats dc(Account_Name) as accounts
index=ad_lab EventCode=4662 "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" Account_Name!="*$" | stats dc(Account_Name) as accounts

index=ad_lab (EventCode=4768 OR EventCode=4769) | eval Account_Name=lower(replace(Account_Name, "@CORP\.LOCAL", "")) | search Account_Name!="*$" | bucket _time span=1h | stats count(eval(EventCode=4768)) as AS_REQ_count, count(eval(EventCode=4769)) as TGS_count by Account_Name, _time | where AS_REQ_count=0 AND TGS_count>0 | stats count
index=ad_lab EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=3 Authentication_Package=NTLM Account_Name!="*$" | stats count

panel.title: 1a. Kerberoasting — Who is requesting RC4 tickets (attacker)

search.query: index=ad_lab EventCode=4769 Ticket_Encryption_Type=0x17 Account_Name!="*$" | stats count as tgs_requests, dc(Service_Name) as distinct_targets by Account_Name | where tgs_requests > 5 | sort - tgs_requests
index=ad_lab EventCode=4769 Ticket_Encryption_Type=0x17 Account_Name!="*$" | stats count by Service_Name | sort - count
index=ad_lab EventCode=4768 Pre_Authentication_Type=0 | stats count, values(Client_Address) as source_ip by Account_Name | sort - count

panel.title: 3. DCSync — Non-DC accounts requesting replication rights

search.query: index=ad_lab EventCode=4662 "1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2" Account_Name!="*$" | stats count, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by Account_Name | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort - count

panel.title: 4. Golden Ticket — TGS requests with no matching TGT

search.query: index=ad_lab (EventCode=4768 OR EventCode=4769) | eval Account_Name=lower(replace(Account_Name, "@CORP\.LOCAL", "")) | search Account_Name!="*$" | bucket _time span=1h | stats count(eval(EventCode=4768)) as AS_REQ_count, count(eval(EventCode=4769)) as TGS_count by Account_Name, _time | where AS_REQ_count=0 AND TGS_count>0 | sort - _time

panel.title: 5. Pass-the-Hash — NTLM network logons for domain accounts

search.query: index=ad_lab EventCode=4624 Logon_Type=3 Authentication_Package=NTLM Account_Name!="*$" | table _time, Account_Name, Source_Network_Address, Workstation_Name | sort - _time

panel.title: 6. Attack Timeline — All suspicious event types

search.query: index=ad_lab (EventCode=4768 OR EventCode=4769 OR EventCode=4662 OR EventCode=4624) | eval attack_type=case( EventCode=4662 AND searchmatch("1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2"), "DCSync", EventCode=4624 AND Authentication_Package="NTLM" AND Logon_Type=3, "Pass-the-Hash", EventCode=4769 AND Ticket_Encryption_Type="0x17", "Kerberoasting", EventCode=4768 AND Pre_Authentication_Type="0", "AS-REP Roasting", 1=1, "other") | where attack_type!="other" | timechart span=1h count by attack_type
